'''Ssurians''' (or '''great dragons''') were major [[Reptile/Legends|reptilian]] predators on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Dathomir/Legends|Dathomir]]. Their hides were so thick and their teeth so sharp that most creatures would simply avoid them rather than fight. The [[Scream of the Ssurian]], a powerful [[Nightsisters/Legends|Nightsister]] [[Force power/Legends|spell]], allowed its caster to reproduce the great dragon's hunting call and territorial warning.<ref name="BOS" />

Like all reptiles, the Ssurians were cold-[[Blood/Legends|blooded]] [[Skeleton/Legends|vertebrates]].<ref name="AE">''[[Alien Encounters]]''</ref>
